(2) Petitioner has challenged order
dated 19.2.2022, passed by Executive
officer, Nagar Palika Parishad, Pithoragarh.
By the said order, petitioner's request for
allotment of shop was turned down and he
was informed that as and when public
notice is issued, as per provisions of
Uttarakhand Procurement Rules, petitioner
can apply for allotment of shop.
(3) Learned Counsel for the petitioner
submits that petitioner was given
permission to construct a toilet and also to
raise a shop next to the toilet, however
both toilet and shop were demolished due
to road widening. He submits that
petitioner needs to be rehabilitated, as
earlier also Nagar Palika had allotted him
land for construction of shop and toilet.
(4) This Court do not find any scope
for interference with the impugned rejection
order dated 19.2.2022. Nagar Palika as a
public authority is bound by Procurement

UKHC010152882022
2026:UHC:7482
Rules, therefore the statement contained in
the rejection order that petitioner will have
to apply for allotment whenever public
notice is issued, cannot be faulted.
(5) Writ petition is, accordingly,
disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
make application as and when public notice
is issued. However, petitioner shall be at
liberty to approach the competent court
seeking compensation and if he files a suit,
the same shall be heard and decided on
merits.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
